comment: Yao Laoshi is amazing! She's very clear and very understanding. She really wants her students to do well and takes time out of her schedule and holds extra study sessions before exams. There is a fair amount of homework and a vocab quiz almost every class. Don't skip class because attendance is part of your grade. She will be missed!

Yao Laoshi is a wonderful teacher and a wonderful person! She is so nice and helpful and makes learning Chinese far easier than I could have imagined. The only negative thing I have to say is that she is returning to China at the end of the year, so she will be missed! If you have the chance at any point, take a class with her!

Yao jie's a good teacher. She explains everything well and clearly. This class isn't that hard, but it is Chinese. You have to put in the time to learn the vocab and do the homework, if you do that, an A is very attainable. She's a really easy grader, and homework is usually not bad, only 1 or 2 worksheets. She gives vocab quizes very often.
